sources.entry: Airtable -A user-friendly platform that blends spreadsheet features with database functionality for organizing projects, managing content, and tracking inventories#freemium

summary.name: Airtable
summary.one_liner: Airtable is a no-code platform that blends spreadsheet-style interfaces with database functionality to build AI-powered workflows, apps and agents.
use_cases: Building AI-powered internal apps without code
Running AI translation or analysis across large asset sets
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Airtable as a workspace for building AI-powered workflows, apps and agents without code. Users can generate apps through conversational building using no-code components. Airtable agents are said to work across thousands of records and orchestrate actions across operations. The page lists enterprise features including HyperDB with record limits in the hundreds of millions, admin roles and fine-grained permissions, and AI model access from providers such as OpenAI, Gemini, Llama and Anthropic. Security claims include ISO, HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance, and European and Australian data residency support.
notable: Conversational app generation with no-code components
HyperDB with record limits in the hundreds of millions
Models run inside Airtable's AWS environment; no customer data used to train AI models
Enterprise admin controls including RBAC, audit logs, EKM and IDP synced groups
caveats: Pricing tiers are not detailed on the page; freemium status comes from the listing, not the page text
Marketing-heavy page; enterprise feature claims are not independently verified here
